# Hirobius Design System

> Token-first React design system for product UIs, with machine-readable context for AI agents: which component to use for each screen need, the tokens, and the rules.

Version: 0.41.0

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/AGENTS.md): which component fits each screen need, the imports, the rules. Read it first.
- [hds-mcp](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/mcp/hds-mcp.mjs): MCP server (stdio): run `npx hds-mcp`. Tools `list_core`, `search_components`, `get_component`, `search_tokens`.
- [ESLint plugin](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/scripts/eslint-plugin-hds/index.mjs): lint before finishing: spread `hds.configs.recommended` (from `@hirobius/design-system/eslint-plugin`) into `eslint.config.mjs`.

## Full bundle

- [llms-full.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms-full.txt): everything in one file: voice, pick by need, layout and scroll recipes, card anatomy, tokens, DESIGN.md and a props digest for every component.

## Topic slices

- [layout.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/layout.txt): screen layout recipe, card anatomy, elevation roles
- [tokens.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/tokens.txt): token rules and the quick token reference
- [scroll.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/scroll.txt): scroll-driven section recipe
- [components.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/components.txt): component inventory pointer, API pointer, props digest
- [upgrade.txt](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/llms/upgrade.txt): upgrade steps, removals, deprecations

## Reference data

- [hds-manifest.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/public/hds-manifest.json): component and pattern inventory, metadata, phase status.
- [component-api.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/src/app/data/component-api.json): prop types, unions, defaults, descriptions per component.
- [hirobius.tokens.json](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/hirobius.tokens.json): token source of truth (W3C DTCG). Prefer `semantic.*`, `component.*` over `primitive.*`.

## Docs

- [DESIGN.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/DESIGN.md): visual spec: surfaces, type, spacing, motion.
- [CONSUMING.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/CONSUMING.md): install and use the package.
- [UPGRADING.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/UPGRADING.md): what changed and what to run.

## Optional

- [MIGRATIONS.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/MIGRATIONS.md): breaking-change notes.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://unpkg.com/@hirobius/design-system/CHANGELOG.md): releases.
